classification.difficultyReason: Combine powers of ten and interpret the resulting products to count zeros.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many zeros are there in the number $10^{10}\times10^{20}\times10^{30}$?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}10^{10}\times10^{20}\times10^{30}&=10^{10+20+30}\\10^{10}\times10^{20}\times10^{30}&=10^{60}\end{align*}$$
$10^{60}$ is 1 followed by 60 zeros, so there are 60 zeros.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How many zeros are there in the number $(2\times10^5)\times(3\times10^6)\times(7\times10^7)$?

answer.short:
18 zeros.

The product is $42\times10^{18}$, which is 42 followed by 18 zeros.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}(2\times10^5)\times(3\times10^6)\times(7\times10^7)&=(2\times3\times7)\times10^{5+6+7}\\(2\times10^5)\times(3\times10^6)\times(7\times10^7)&=42\times10^{18}\end{align*}$$
This is 42 followed by 18 zeros. Since 42 contains no zeros, there are 18 zeros altogether.
